# KINGAI Security

## English
KINGAI Security is the KING AI ecosystem endpoint-security and antivirus product family. Public positioning focuses on understandable protection, scanning, real-time defense workflows, quarantine, protection history, safer updates and a long-term path toward intelligent endpoint defense. This public repository does not publish proprietary detection logic or private security implementation.

Official ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work
Business & partnership: vip@kingai.work
Public facts: README.md
Business direction: BUSINESS.md
Roadmap: ROADMAP.md

## 中文
KINGAI Security 是 KING AI 主生态的终端安全与杀毒产品。公开定位强调简单易懂的保护体验、扫描、实时防护流程、隔离区、保护历史、安全更新以及长期智能终端防御方向。本公开仓不发布专有检测逻辑或私有安全实现。

官网：https://www.kingai.work
商务与合作：vip@kingai.work
公开事实：README.md
商业方向：BUSINESS.md
路线图：ROADMAP.md
